question: Should OpenClaw now make `imsg 0.11.1` the mandatory iMessage floor and retire `coalesceSameSenderDms`, accepting that stale config and older binaries require explicit upgrade recovery?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but the timing of a persisted-config removal and fail-closed dependency floor is an operator-impact decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Prove and land the new floor
options.body: Accept the ownership transfer after exact-head live split-send and doctor-upgrade proof, then require `imsg 0.11.1` or newer.

options.title: Defer the cleanup
options.body: Keep the existing OpenClaw fallback until maintainers are ready to make the newer `imsg` version an unconditional supported floor.

recommendation.title: Prove and land the new floor
recommendation.body: Accept the ownership transfer after exact-head live split-send and doctor-upgrade proof, then require `imsg 0.11.1` or newer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iMessage ownership makes this the best available routing candidate for the upgrade-boundary decision.
